refined_rule.exact_id_scope: Possible identity overlap from admitted native self endpoints or saved round trips is unknown, not proved incompatible. Different population labels or an indirect route are insufficient exclusion reasons. Directness is a Jev preference; actual retrieval/answer assessment still decides sufficiency.
refined_rule.named_scope: Explicit ac_descendants or other named population obligations require matching population metadata and established completeness. An endpoint/dependency recipe cannot establish a hierarchy count merely because some returned IDs overlap.
refined_rule.kind_control: A proved disjoint endpoint kind remains incompatible; absent endpoint kind metadata stays unknown.
